doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Leading his own group in Dayton with Slam Stewart and Booty Wood
summary: Young confirms he led a group in Dayton with Booty Wood and Slam Stewart in the early 1950s.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Ok. So there‘s a gap in the early ‗50s, did you go back to Dayton and lead your own band?
It would‘ve been after, it would‘ve been sometime [laughs] that‘s a good question, sometime after ‘48.
After you left Basie‘s band in ‘48, did you go back to Dayton at that point?
Oh boy…did I go back to Dayton? Where did I go?
It says you led your own group with Booty Wood and you had Slam…
You had your own group with Booty Wood and Slam Stewart
Yes, that was in Dayton. What year was that?
Yeah, that‘s got to be…hmmm…Slam Stewart, yeah.
So that would‘ve been in the early ‗50s, I guess. It doesn‘t say exactly.
